name: Department of Archaeology — gazetted protected monuments, Barishal Division (district PDF lists)
organization: প্রত্নতত্ত্ব অধিদপ্তর (Department of Archaeology), Ministry of Cultural Affairs
attribution: প্রত্নতত্ত্ব অধিদপ্তর (Department of Archaeology), Ministry of Cultural Affairs
notes: Page 'বরিশাল বিভাগের সংরক্ষিত পুরাকীর্তি' links one PDF per district for all 6 districts (28 monuments; lists published 2024-08-31, Pirojpur 2025-07-13, Bhola 2026-08-10). PDFs mix Bijoy/SutonnyMJ text (converted to Unicode by fetch.py, bijoy2uni) and Unicode text layers; Bhola-01 has a broken Unicode text layer and was read from the rendered page (ROW_FIXES_BY_DIV['barishal']); conversion slips and Patuakhali-06's split English gazette reference are fixed in TEXT_FIXES_BY_DIV['barishal'] after checking the rendered pages. Photo captions are dropped. Coordinates are as published (DMS); Barishal-06 and Pirojpur-04 print their labels irregularly and are parsed as printed; Pirojpur-06's malformed coordinates are not used (kept in extra_json). The HDX COD-AB Barishal extract (hdx_cod_ab_bgd_barishal) was not in the repository at collection time, so the point-in-polygon QA did not run. Descriptions are not copied; only a construction-date phrase. Licence not stated.
